seo.title: Split PDF Files Online — Free & Secure | JDpdf
seo.description: Split a PDF into multiple smaller files by page count. Free, fast, and private — no installation required.

subtitle: Split one PDF into several smaller files, a fixed number of pages at a time.

options.pagesPerFileHint: e.g. 2 splits a 10-page PDF into 5 files

howItWorks.title: How to split a PDF file
steps: Upload the PDF file you want to split.
Choose how many pages each file should contain.
Click Split and download each resulting PDF.

items.a: Yes, splitting PDFs is free within the daily usage limits shown above.

items.q: Will my file be kept private?
items.a: Yes. Files are processed securely and automatically deleted after a short retention period.

items.q: How many files will I get?
items.a: One file for every group of pages you choose — for example, splitting a 10-page PDF every 2 pages produces 5 files.
